list: The official 55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze, 28 hidden
notes: Every trophy is single-player. There are no online trophies at launch.

The game has no mission replay and no New Game Plus (reported at launch), so every one-shot story moment is effectively missable. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter and one before the final mission.
Cheats disable trophies (reported by PowerPyx; Rockstar Support confirmed the same rule for GTA V).
The story alone takes around 60 hours; the platinum is long, not hard, at roughly 200 hours (press estimates).
Rockstar has not spelled out what 100% completion covers, so this guide says so honestly instead of inventing a checklist.
sources: Exophase PS5 trophy listing (official names, descriptions and grades)
PSNProfiles PS5 trophy listing (official names, descriptions and grades)
TrueAchievements list (cross-check of names, descriptions and grades)
PowerPyx GTA VI trophy guide (cheats disable trophies; no mission replay)
PSNProfiles GTA V trophy guide (series mechanics that carry over from GTA V)
PowerPyx GTA V trophy guide (series mechanics that carry over from GTA V)

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and the platinum pops on its own. It is a marathon, not a skill wall: the press estimate is roughly 200 hours, most of it story, collectibles and cleanup. Work the roadmap in order, story first, then collectibles and activities, then money and property, and keep a manual save at the start of every chapter so a missed one-off never costs a full replay.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.missable_note: Opening mission Gone Fishing: a one-shot story moment. No mission replay is reported at launch, so keep a manual save before starting.
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing through to its end and the trophy pops when the mission completes. It is the game's first story beat, so there is nothing to prepare. Treat it as missable: with no mission replay reported at launch, a missed story moment means an earlier manual save or a new playthrough.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.missable_note: Chapter 1 finale: a one-shot story moment. Keep a manual save at the start of Chapter 1.
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1 and the trophy pops at the chapter's end. Before the finale, visit the Chapter 1 meditation spot: it is the one confirmed missable in the sources and can be lost after this chapter, so do that stop first and then close the chapter.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.missable_note: Chapter 2 finale: a one-shot story moment. Keep a manual save at the start of Chapter 2.
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2 and the trophy pops at the chapter's end. Play the missions in order and keep a manual save from the start of the chapter, since story moments cannot be replayed once the chapter closes.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.missable_note: Chapter 3 finale: a one-shot story moment. Keep a manual save at the start of Chapter 3.
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3 and the trophy pops at the chapter's end. The chapter moves the story into Vice City itself, so expect new activities to open up along the way; finish the story missions first and mop up the side content after.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.missable_note: Chapter 4 finale: a one-shot story moment. Keep a manual save at the start of Chapter 4.
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4 and the trophy pops at the chapter's end. This is the last chapter before the finale, so it is the last good moment to clear open stranger strands and activities before the endgame.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.missable_note: Final mission: a one-shot story moment. Keep a manual save before starting it.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission and the gold pops when it ends. Make a manual save before you start it: it is the last story moment in the game and there is no mission replay to fall back on. After it, free roam stays open for the cleanup stages of this guide.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.missable_note: Mission Breakfast Run: a one-shot story moment. Keep a manual save before the mission.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Named story missions pop their trophy the moment the mission ends. Because there is no mission replay, keep a manual save from before the mission in case anything in it goes sideways.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.missable_note: Mission The Cartel Heist: a one-shot story moment. Keep a manual save before the mission.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. It is one of the big set-piece heists of the story, and its trophy pops when the mission ends. Stock up on armour and ammo before you start, and keep a manual save from before the mission.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.missable_note: Mission Child's Play: a one-shot story moment. Keep a manual save before the mission.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Its trophy pops when the mission ends. Like every named story mission, it cannot be replayed, so keep a manual save from before it starts.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.missable_note: Mission Headliners: a one-shot story moment. Keep a manual save before the mission.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Its trophy pops when the mission ends. Keep a manual save from before the mission, as with every named story mission in this guide.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.missable_note: Mission VCIA Takedown: a one-shot story moment. Keep a manual save before the mission.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. Its trophy pops when the mission ends. Keep a manual save from before the mission, since airport story moments cannot be replayed.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.missable_note: Mission Operation Savage Glory: a one-shot story moment. Keep a manual save before the mission.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Its trophy pops when the mission ends. It is the last of the six named story missions in this guide, so finishing it closes out the named-mission set.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion. Rockstar has not spelled out what 100% covers, so the honest plan is: finish the story, all eight stranger strands, all collectibles, all activities and all property, then check the in-game stats page for what is left. Do not trust any checklist that claims a fixed list Rockstar never published; work from the game's own completion counter instead.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts are jumps, near misses, long airtime and other driving feats, and the game counts them as you play, so this one grows across a full playthrough on its own. To push it along, chain stunt jumps and long jumps off ramps and hills between missions instead of fast-travelling everywhere.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once: nine types in all. One attempt at each is enough, no win required, so work through the activities list early and tick them off as you find them: races, the shooting range, drone races, fishing, the arcade, and the rest. The trophy pops on the ninth type you try.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges: 42 challenges per the official listing. Gold each challenge one by one and replay any that fall short until they clear. Take your time on the later challenges and learn each one's target pattern before you chase the gold time.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location: 14 locations. A win at a location checks it off, so you need one win per spot, not a clean sweep of every race. Fly each course once to learn its line, then race it for the win.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Each race counts once, so winning the same race again adds nothing: work through the race list across Leonida and tick off a new one each time. Mix cars, bikes and boats where the race list offers them, since different race types still count toward the twenty.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.missable_note: Fishing challenge against Cal: a one-time challenge. Keep a manual save before it; no confirmed window yet.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. The challenge is a one-off, so keep a manual save before you take it on: no confirmed window exists yet for a retry. Out-fish Cal in the challenge itself and the trophy pops at the result screen.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Find any arcade machine in Leonida, play one game through to its end, and the trophy pops. Pick the shortest game on the machine if you only want the trophy and not the high score.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.missable_note: Final mission for Andy: a one-shot stranger finale. Keep a manual save before it.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Stranger strands unlock across Leonida as you explore; play Andy's strand through to its last mission and the trophy pops when it ends. Keep a manual save before the finale: stranger finales are one-shot story moments with no replay.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.missable_note: Final mission for Kenton: a one-shot stranger finale. Keep a manual save before it.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Play Kenton's stranger strand through to its last mission and the trophy pops when it ends. Keep a manual save before the finale, as with every stranger finale in this guide.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.missable_note: Final mission for Billy: a one-shot stranger finale. Keep a manual save before it.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Play Billy's stranger strand through to its last mission and the trophy pops when it ends. Keep a manual save before the finale.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. There are more strands than eight, so finish any eight you like. Each strand ends with its own finale, and the five named finales, for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone, each carry their own trophy too, so the strands feed two trophies at once.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.missable_note: Final mission for Randy: a one-shot stranger finale. Keep a manual save before it.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Play Randy's stranger strand through to its last mission and the trophy pops when it ends. Keep a manual save before the finale.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.missable_note: Final mission for Tyrone: a one-shot stranger finale. Keep a manual save before it.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Play Tyrone's stranger strand through to its last mission and the trophy pops when it ends. Finishing all five named stranger finales also closes the stranger-finale set of this guide.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missable_note: Every meditation spot (18 spots). The Chapter 1 spot is the one confirmed missable: visit it before finishing Chapter 1, or it can be lost.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida: 18 spots in all. Most can be visited in free roam after the story, but one sits in Chapter 1 and is the one confirmed missable in the sources, so meditate there before the chapter ends. Sweep the remaining spots region by region once the map is fully open.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.missable_note: Unique-animal hunt for Bret: a one-time hunt. Keep a manual save before it; no confirmed window yet.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunt is a single quarry, so track it, take the shot cleanly, and the trophy pops when the hunt ends. Treat it as missable until confirmed otherwise and keep a manual save before the hunt, since a failed or skipped hunt may not come back.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida, and a finished set checks off, so you need every card of three sets, not just three cards. Hunt them region by region and trade duplicates where the game lets you; the set counter shows which sets are still short.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Use the WAiNK feature at 100 different spots and each new location counts once, so repeats add nothing. Work through the map methodically and WAiNK at every landmark you pass; the location counter shows how far along you are.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges span combat, driving, exploration and more, and the in-game challenges list tracks your count, so work through the easiest ones first and let the harder ones fall as you play. Fifty is less than the full list, so you can skip the ones you hate.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Build a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay out of the search area until it clears. Do it in open country where escape routes are wide, and keep moving so the search cone never settles on you.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Hit three shops in a row with your partner beside you and keep the wanted level alive through all three: do not let it clear between robberies, and do not get caught. Pick three shops close together and plan the route before the first robbery.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Every new vehicle you enter or spot counts once, so the count climbs naturally as you explore, and faster if you tour dealerships, traffic and parked cars across the map. Rare and mission-only vehicles count too, so keep an eye out during story missions.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus with at least five enemies in range and drop all five before it ends. Pick a fight with a group, such as a gang hideout or a wanted-level shootout, and line the shots up before you trigger it.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.missable_note: Unscheduled departure at VCIA: a one-time airport moment. Keep a manual save before trying it; no confirmed window yet.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, Vice City International Airport. Leave the airport in an unscheduled way and the trophy pops. It is a single moment at the airport, so keep a manual save before you try it, in case the departure does not register.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Deal with Rhino tanks. Rhinos roll out at high wanted levels, so raise the heat until one appears, then engage it: steal it or destroy it and the trophy pops. This one is repeatable, unlike the one-off hidden moments, so there is no missable window to worry about.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: no alarms and no witness spotting you. Plan the approach, move slowly, take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, back out and try another store.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Hit five bank vaults and get away clean each time. Plan an escape route before each robbery, bring a fast car, and break the wanted level after every hit; the count only grows on a clean escape.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Ambush an armored truck on the road, crack it open, grab the cash and escape with it. Trucks run set routes, so watch one first, pick a quiet stretch of road, and have a getaway car ready.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida: 52 areas. Visit every named area on the map and the in-game map tracks which ones you have seen. Tour the state methodically, region by region, and the last unvisited area is usually a small corner you drove past without noticing.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang: 9 gangs. Hit one illegal operation per gang. Each gang's operations are marked once you find them, so work through the list gang by gang and clear the map markers as you go.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.missable_note: Ocean Beach cocktail: a one-time moment. No confirmed window yet; do it when you pass through and keep a manual save.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Sit down for a drink at an Ocean Beach spot with a view and the trophy pops. It is a single quiet moment, so do it when you pass through the area rather than leaving it for the endgame.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.missable_note: Vehicle showroom smash: a one-time moment. Keep a manual save before trying it; no confirmed window yet.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive out through the showroom glass and the trophy pops. It is a single stunt moment, so keep a manual save before you try it, in case the smash does not register.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.missable_note: Kolt & Associates bowling alley follow-through: a one-time moment. No confirmed window yet; keep a manual save.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Play a frame at the alley and follow through on the shot and the trophy pops. Go when you are near the alley rather than saving it for a special trip.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.missable_note: Partnership moment: a one-time moment. No confirmed window yet; keep a manual save around partnership scenes.
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. This is a single story-adjacent moment tied to a partnership, so keep a manual save around partnership scenes and play them through rather than skipping ahead. The trophy pops when the moment lands.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.missable_note: Choices made: PSNProfiles lists a count running to 500. No confirmed window yet; keep a manual save.
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). The trophy tracks choices across the game, and PSNProfiles lists a count running to 500. Make choices as you play, in the story and in side content, and the count climbs until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.missable_note: Second try success: a one-time moment. No confirmed window yet; keep a manual save.
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Fail something once, then succeed on the second try, and the trophy pops on the retry success. If a retry opportunity comes up, take it instead of reloading an old save.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.missable_note: Unexplained event: a one-time moment. No confirmed window yet; keep a manual save.
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Witness something strange, an unexplained event somewhere in Leonida. Keep exploring the odd corners of the map, the places that look out of place, and the moment finds you when you stumble into it.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.missable_note: Melee drive-by: a one-time moment. No confirmed window yet; keep a manual save.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle: a drive-by with a melee weapon, not a gun. Line the pass up on a quiet street and swing as you roll past.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Feed marked bills to your contacts until $250,000 is laundered. Bank jobs and robberies pay in marked bills, so launder them steadily as you earn them rather than stockpiling them for one go.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Cars, clothes, weapons and property purchases all count, so it comes naturally by the endgame. If you fall short, top it up with one big purchase, such as a car or a property, rather than nickel-and-diming small shops.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties: 8 garages. Buy every garage property on the market. Garages also store the vehicles you register, so buy them before the vehicle-collection push and use them as your home base for it.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Register ten vehicles you own in the app. Discovering vehicles feeds this, 100 discovered for Whip It Good and ten registered here, so register the keepers as you find them instead of leaving it all for the end.
